note: Because the entries on fiber f sum to -t, their negative mass is at least t. The row bound nu<=t therefore forces total negative mass exactly t, with no positive entries in f and no negative entries outside f. Since the row has total mass 1, its positive mass is exactly 1+t. The pinned zero masses on the other actor fibers, combined with nonnegativity outside f, exclude positive mass there, leaving only v, w, and any nonactor support fibers.
